title: Unit of Work
summary: Group every read, domain change and write of one business operation into a single commit — or roll all of it back.
signals: a loop of save() calls where a failure halfway leaves partial state
try/catch blocks that swallow errors inside a transaction callback
each repository call opening and committing its own transaction
emails or API calls made inside a DB transaction

roles.batch cancellation: one business operation spanning several aggregates
roles.session / DbContext / transaction handle: the unit of work: tracks changes, owns commit/rollback
roles.flush: send SQL without making it permanent
roles.per-call repository (before): auto-committing writes that can't be undone together

stages.title: Save per call
stages.idea: Each cancellation commits on its own, so a later failure leaves the earlier one persisted.

stages.title: One transaction
stages.idea: All reads, domain calls and writes run inside one scope that commits once or rolls back entirely.

checks: What is the difference between flush and commit?
